name: Cyber Security and Resilience Bill
description: Proposed UK legislation (not yet enacted as of registration), sponsored by the Department for Science, Innovation and Technology (DSIT), expanding UK NIS Regulations 2018 (secid:regulation/gov.uk/nis-regs-2018) coverage to more digital services/supply chains, with stronger regulator enforcement and incident-reporting powers, and covering managed service providers.
relationToCloudSecurity: Establishes statutory or regulatory compliance obligations issued by United Kingdom Government (gov.uk) applicable to cloud service providers, data controllers, and digital operators.
relationToAISecurity: Governs data protection, automated decision-making, cybersecurity, or AI system compliance within United Kingdom Government (gov.uk).
